issues.issue: Was the RAD's finding that Mr. Ifaloye has a viable internal flight alternative (IFA) in Nigeria reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: RAD unreasonably endorsed the RPD's finding that his agents could not find him; his burn scars and dialysis make IFAs unreasonable; analysis was cursory.
issues.respondent_position: Not stated; the court finds the onus was on him and he did not contest the first IFA prong before the RAD.
issues.result_quote: The RAD reasonably concluded that Mr. Ifaloye had failed to discharge the heavy burden of establishing that he could not seek refuge in Port Harcourt, Abuja, or Lagos.
